prompt: A library scene with a senior librarian and several patrons. The librarian is standing behind a wooden desk, holding a book and pointing at a computer screen on the desk. A young student is sitting at a reading table, writing in a notebook with a pen. The student is wearing glasses and has a backpack hanging from the chair. The librarian is older than the student. Behind the student, there are tall bookshelves. A ladder is leaning against the bookshelves. An elderly woman is climbing the ladder, reaching for a thick, leather-bound book on the top shelf. This book is thicker than the paperback books next to it. On the reading table, there are two pens and a group of pencils; the number of pencils is twice the number of pens. There is also one eraser on the table, which is one less than the number of pens. A coffee cup sits next to the notebook.
